tracks.title: today is my favorite
tracks.excerpt: An album-length EP by the 20-year-old producer is a dizzying and boundless collage of collages, using free-jazz logic and digital overload to chart new emotional terrain.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位20岁的制片人制作了一张专辑长度的EP ，这是一张令人眼花缭乱的无限拼贴画，使用自由爵士逻辑和数字过载来绘制新的情感地形。

tracks.title: Psychic Video
tracks.excerpt: The UK selector throws caution—and genre—to the winds on an audacious 82-minute set that careens between ambient, drill’n’bass, post-punk, breakcore, and more.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 英国选择器在一个大胆的82分钟集合中对风投以谨慎和流派，该集合在环境， drill 'n 'bass ， post-punk ， breakcore等之间进行调整。

That tingling feeling is tortuously triggering. Attentive listening is what is calling for Spydergum. This is the way the expansive electroacoustic ensemble mark the year with their most anticipated eponymous
tracks.excerpt_zh: Spydergum Spydergum这支大型即兴乐团的成员包括Concepción Huerta、Luka Aron等人，汇聚了众多元素。Spydergum的《Spydergum》它粘稠，能渗透肌肤。那种刺痛感令人痛苦地兴奋。Spydergum需要的是用心聆听。这就是这个庞大的电子声学乐团以他们最受期待的同名作品来为这一年留下印记的方式。

tracks.title: School's Out!
tracks.excerpt: The irreverent duo of Leo Fincham and Rowan Please plies its brilliantly digitized indie-pop bricolage on an album with the ragtag splendor of a low-budget musical.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 不敬的Leo Fincham和Rowan Please二人组合将其精彩的数字化独立流行拼凑在一张专辑中，并伴随着低成本音乐剧的破烂辉煌。

tracks.title: Favourite T-Shirt
tracks.excerpt: Birthday girl Ella Mai celebrates turning 32 with the release of the surprise project ‘3two,’ and she is in lovergirl mode on the EP. The post Ella Mai Chooses Love On Surprise EP ‘3two’ appeared first on SoulBounce .
tracks.excerpt_zh: 寿星Ella Mai以惊喜项目“3two”的发布来庆祝自己32岁生日，在这张EP中，她处于“恋爱少女”模式。这篇文章《Ella Mai在惊喜EP《3two》中选择爱情》最初发表在SoulBounce上。

tracks.title: This is How it Should Be Done
tracks.excerpt: For their collaborative full-length debut, Eris Drew and Octo Octa hunkered down in their New Hampshire cabin to craft a celebratory, sample-heavy tribute to the maximalist dance music of yore.
tracks.excerpt_zh: Eris Drew和Octo Octa在他们的新罕布什尔州小木屋里蹲下，为他们合作的全长首演制作了一个庆祝性的样品，向昔日的极致舞曲致敬。

tracks.title: It's the Coming Down
tracks.excerpt: Best remembered for the unhinged rockabilly of “Bop-a-Lena” and Brenda Lee’s “I’m Sorry,” Ronnie Self spent much of his later career writing songs that went largely unheard. The Lost Sessions , a collection of seventeen recordings from that period, finds him somewhere between country, folk-rock, and the lonely hours of the night. A long-overdue glimpse of the songwriter behind the legend. The post
tracks.excerpt_zh: Ronnie Self以“Bop-a-Lena”和Brenda Lee的“I 'm Sorry”的摇滚歌曲而闻名，他后来的大部分职业生涯都在写歌，这些歌曲在很大程度上是闻所未闻的。The Lost Sessions收录了那段时期的17张唱片，发现他在乡村、民谣摇滚和孤独的夜晚之间的某个地方。姗姗来迟的瞥见传说背后的词曲作者。帖子
